pr_title: app: gracefully shut down `ollama serve` on windows

issue_context.title: [v0.1.32-pre for Windows] ollama server does not exit quitting from the system tray icon
issue_context.body:
### What is the issue?

ollama is not stopped when quitting using the system tray icon

### What did you expect to see?

ollama app.exe and ollama.exe not running anymore

### Steps to reproduce

just quit from the system tray icon

### Are there any recent changes that introduced the issue?

This issue is new with the pre-release version

### OS

Windows

### Architecture

amd64

review_comments: @dhiltgen I don't think we need the `0x08000000` but wanted to verify with you

It seems the combination of:

```
HideWindow:    true,
CreationFlags: windows.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP,
```

does not require `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` anymore
